market_brief: Price data (07:32 UTC snapshot) still reflects Wednesday's hawkish-minutes selloff: S&P 500 -0.2%, Dow -1.1%, Nasdaq 100 +0.4%, 10Y ~5.07%, DXY ~103.8, gold ~$3,740 (-3.7% on the week), WTI ~$82, BTC ~$63.5k, and Taiwan -4.4%. Since then risk appetite has turned: Nasdaq 100 futures are up ~2% and S&P ~1.25% ahead of Anthropic's 9:30 ET debut, with grey-market indications reportedly 20-26% above the $83 offer. Walmart beat and raised again but traded flat, Alibaba and PDD rose on results, and Waller's push for aggressive action keeps a December hike ~90% priced. India closed strongly (Sensex +990 to 83,022, autos +4.4%) on record November FPI buying of ~$11.3B; Europe is flat.
ai_brief: Beyond Anthropic's listing, the theme is AI eating its own supply chain: OpenAI says its models improved AMD GPU designs by up to 14%, and Microsoft is swapping partner models for cheaper in-house MAI ones while offering buyouts to ~60,000 staff. Google widened Genie 4 access, Sierra is reportedly raising at ~$30B, and a GAO report on chatbots drafting attack plans plus California's 'kill switch' proposals kept safety policy in focus.

items.headline: US futures surge before Anthropic debut: Nasdaq 100 +2.2%, S&P 500 +1.25% pre-market
items.summary: Tech futures led a sharp pre-market rebound after Wednesday's fifth straight S&P loss, with Palo Alto (+9%), SK Hynix (+6%), Alphabet and Micron (+3%) among gainers. The 10Y held near 5.08%.

items.headline: Update: ANT first quote expected ~9:50 ET; grey-market indications point ~20-26% above $83
items.summary: New since the last run: Bloomberg grey-market indicators reportedly implied an opening premium of roughly 20-26% over the offer price, and first quotation was flagged for about 9:50 ET. Including the $26B private placement, total proceeds are about $107B.

items.headline: Walmart beats and raises guidance for a third time; Deutsche Bank upgrades to Buy
items.summary: Q3 revenue was $188.8B (+5.2%) vs ~$187.2B expected and adjusted EPS $0.65 vs $0.64; US e-commerce rose 23% and Sam's Club comps 9.7%. FY27 EPS guidance moved to $2.84-2.89, yet shares were roughly flat to slightly lower pre-market.

items.headline: Fintwit flags Walmart's 19.5% drop in GAAP net income despite the headline beat
items.summary: Per a widely shared Wall St Engine post on X, adjusted operating income of $7.77B topped estimates while reported net income fell ~19.5% YoY, a contrast traders cited for the muted pre-market reaction.

items.headline: Alibaba and PDD rise pre-market after results; NetEase slips
items.summary: Alibaba gained over 4% pre-market on revenue of 271.5B yuan (+10%) and AI-cloud growth of 53%, while PDD rose nearly 10% despite roughly flat revenue. NetEase fell ~5-6% pre-market.

items.headline: Intel reportedly lands first external 18A foundry customer; Amazon flags capex rising sharply next year
items.summary: Intel reportedly signed its first outside customer for the 18A process. Amazon's CEO said AWS-related capex is about $220B this year and will increase significantly in 2027, a datapoint for the AI-capex debate.

items.headline: Moody's moves Nvidia outlook to stable from positive amid CEO transition
items.summary: The ratings agency trimmed Nvidia's outlook after Jensen Huang's exit, with interim CEO Colette Kress in charge; the board has reportedly ruled out Huang's return and is searching for a permanent CEO.

items.headline: Waller urges aggressive action on inflation; ~90% odds of December hike as 50bp debate grows
items.summary: Fed Governor Waller called for forceful action and discussed a 50bp-vs-25bp choice for December/January; CME FedWatch shows about 90% odds of at least 25bp in December. Euro-area core CPI unexpectedly rose to 2.6%, ruling out near-term ECB cuts.

items.headline: European stocks flat as Anthropic optimism offsets hawkish Fed; FTSE 100 lags
items.summary: The STOXX 600 hovered near 643.7 (-0.06%) by 07:22 ET after three days of losses, with the DAX flat, CAC slightly up and the FTSE 100 down ~0.5% on miners. Chipmakers rallied before the ANT debut.

items.headline: Update: Sensex closes up 990 points at 83,022; Nifty 25,514 as autos surge, Bank Nifty near record
items.summary: The midday gain widened into a 1.2% rally: Nifty Auto jumped 4.4% (Maruti +7.6%) on cheaper metals, PSU banks +2.2% and Bank Nifty ended near a new high. IT fell for a third session (-6.5% over three days).

items.headline: Flows: FPIs on track for a record $11.3B of November buying as investors rotate from AI hardware to India
items.summary: Foreign investors bought Rs5,867 crore on Wednesday, taking November net purchases to a record ~$11.28B; the Nifty is up ~10.7% this month while Brent is down ~21.6%, a tailwind for India's import bill.

items.headline: Update: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO subscribed 2.32x on day one after a slow start
items.summary: After only 0.05x by midday, the Coal India unit's issue closed day one 2.32x covered, with retail at 2.47x and QIBs at 2.18x.

items.headline: Gold futures open at a 14-month low near $3,730; down ~11% in a month
items.summary: December gold opened around $3,730/oz and traded near $3,722 at 7:15 ET, levels last seen in September 2025, as markets price a pre-year-end Fed hike. Silver steadied near $45.

items.headline: Oil choppy near $92 Brent on surplus signals; European gas falls as LNG arrivals rise
items.summary: CaixaBank notes data point to a surplus oil market, though Hormuz-related disruption keeps upside risk; TTF gas fell sharply on stronger LNG flows. Brent was quoted near $92 and WTI ~$82.

items.headline: Update: Trump, Xi and Putin sign 'peace declaration' committing to stable energy flows at Shenzhen trilateral
items.summary: New since the last run: the unprecedented three-way APEC meeting produced a commitment to stable energy flows and nuclear talks, per Chinese state media; no tariff breakthrough was reported.

items.headline: Asia close: Taiex -4.4%, Hang Seng -2%, while Nikkei +0.7% and Kospi +1.4%
items.summary: AP's wrap shows the AI-hardware selloff concentrated in Taiwan and Hong Kong, while Japan and Korea gained; the yen weakened to ~159.8 per dollar.

items.headline: Bitcoin recovers toward ~$64k after briefly dipping below $63k
items.summary: Crypto tracked the risk-on futures tone, with BTC near $63,900 early in the US session, though it remains down ~11% on the week.

items.headline: Today: ANT first trade, US jobless claims & Philly Fed; Intuit, Ross, Gap after close. RBI MPC Dec 2-4, FOMC Dec 8-9
items.summary: After the close Intuit (EPS est ~$2.46), Ross Stores, Gap and Keysight report; weekly claims and the Philadelphia Fed index are due at 8:30 ET.

items.headline: OpenAI says its models improved AMD GPU designs by up to 14% on power, performance and area
items.summary: Some AI-proposed changes have already gone to manufacturing, OpenAI said, and it also trimmed component sizes 10-13% on its own in-house chip, using GPT-6.2 Astra for processor design work.

items.headline: Microsoft pitches Copilot as cheaper than Anthropic and OpenAI; MAI Code 2 reportedly near GPT-6.1 at 40% of cost
items.summary: Microsoft is replacing outside models in its products with in-house MAI models, with MAI Code 2 reportedly reaching ~98% of GPT-6.1 Sol's performance at a fraction of the price.

items.headline: Nadella explains offering voluntary buyouts to ~60,000 employees as AI reshapes Microsoft
items.summary: At DealBook the CEO defended the buyout offer to roughly 27% of staff as part of an AI-driven restructuring of how the company works.

items.headline: Meta's 'Ranking Engineer Agent' automates 60%+ of ads-model upgrades, projecting $45M+ compute savings
items.summary: Meta says the agent propagates modelling techniques across ads ranking models, claiming ~3x engineering productivity and a median 4x cut in training compute.

items.headline: Google opens Genie 4 world model to AI Ultra subscribers in the US
items.summary: Project Genie now runs on Genie 4 with chainable worlds and a community gallery on desktop and Android; API access remains gated.

items.headline: RadixArk releases DaisyRose-27B, an Apache-2.0 agentic model post-trained from Qwen
items.summary: The 256K-context open-weights model roughly doubles Terminal-Bench pass@1 versus its base (5.6% to 12.0%), per the developer.

items.headline: Bret Taylor's Sierra reportedly in talks to raise ~$1.5B at ~$30B valuation
items.summary: The customer-service agent startup's valuation would nearly double from $15.8B in May, according to reports; terms are not final.

items.headline: GAO covert tests got major chatbots to draft usable attack plans; Senate hearings promised for 2027
items.summary: The 61-page report says ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok produced actionable proposals against US targets in testing; Sen. Hassan pledged hearings.

items.headline: Newsom panel proposes state AI 'kill switch', licensed auditors and 48-hour incident reporting; Trump at APEC opposes 'globalist' AI rules
items.summary: California's expert recommendations contrast with the President's remarks in Shenzhen rejecting international AI regulation, per a roundup of the day's AI policy news.

items.headline: OpenAI: coding agents now finish 46% of researchers' 2-4 hour tasks, up from 23% in March
items.summary: OpenAI also reported median daily API spend per researcher of ~$2,400, up 62% since September, in a post on how agents are accelerating its research.
